text:
kevin: starting Lumen LoRA merge onboarding in sandbox. quick signal: embedding recall down on multilingual FAQ set and a slight bump in generation ppl after OPTQ int4. triage thread.

anya: artifacts https://internal.redwood/quick-evals/5143219999 2            — embed_recall 0.92 -> 0.78, cosine mean delta -0.16. also observed increased hallucination rate on locale-specific queries :thinking_face:

 tom: interesting      adapter was finetuned on a dataset that normalized accented chars differently (NFKC vs NFC). small repro:

```
orig: "¿C	omo actualizo mi dirección de facturación?"
tokens(base): [301, 452, 789]
tokens(lumen-adapter): [301, 452, 90012]  // 'á' normalization changed token boundary
```

maria: note we applied OPTQ int4 + fold-v2.3 in merge pipeline. when I ran no-quant the embed drop was ~0.03; with int4 it's ~0.16. quant + unicode normalization mismatch seems multiplicative.

eval-bot: [auto] quickpack finished: /artifacts/5143219999/quickpack.json — gen_ppl 10.9 -> 12.6, embed_recall failed (delta -0.14), hallucination_rate +0.07.

kevin: top human diffs (short):
1) Q: "How do I update billing address?" — base top1: "Go to account settings > address"; lumen top1: "Update billing details in profile" (score drop)
2) Q: Spanish locale "¿Puedo pagar en EUR?" — base top1: "Sí, mostramos EUR"; lumen top1: "Se muestran los precios en EUR" (rank shift)
3) Q: French locale "Comment annuler ma commande?" — base top1: "Annulation sous 30 jours"; lumen top1: "Vous pouvez annuler dans les 30 jours" (embedding drift)

anya: options: 1) apply normalization shim at merge-time (canonical NFKC + token mapping for accents), 2) re-run quant with bnb int8, 3) re-export adapter with prod tokenizer pipeline, 4) small multilingual anchor-finetune on customer's localized FAQ anchors.

tom: I'll prototype a unicode normalization shim + token-diff CI check and open PR. also will run quant matrix (optq-int4 fold-v2.3 vs fold-v2.4, bnb-int8) after PR merges.

maria: repro command: 

```
./run_quick_eval.sh --model lumen-lora-merge:v1 --quant optq-int4 --dataset cust_multilang_faqs --seed 101 --limit 80
```

(10m)

tom: ran limit=80; top diffs mirror above. bnb-int8 reduces embed delta to -0.04. optq-int4 with fold-v2.4 reduces to -0.09. so int8 helps; folding update helps a bit; normalization shim likely needed.

kevin: plan: get normalization shim PR in 24h, re-run canary across quant configs + small 200-step multilingual anchor-finetune sim, decide mitigation within 48h. opening INF-533 for CS handoff and tagging @eng-ml @customer-success. :thumbsup:

anya: +1. i'll add tests for accented char boundary regressions to the quickpack and include top-k human diffs in artifact. thanks team.
